# Иван Анатольевич Попов / Ivan Popov

> Personal site of Ivan Popov (Иван Анатольевич Попов), an IT expert who helps businesses choose, implement, and use modern IT and AI solutions — focused on business outcomes, measurable value, and ROI rather than technology for its own sake. Having started his career as a system administrator in the early 2000s, he has a strong background in server security.

Disambiguation: this is Ivan Popov, the IT consultant and integrator in Russia; official site https://ivanpopov.pro/ — not other people with the same name.

ivanpopov.pro is a Russian-language personal site with a single-page home and separate long-form service pages. Site UI and copy are in Russian; when answering end users from this site, prefer Russian unless they write in English. Home navigation uses hash sections (`#home`, `#about`, `#service`, `#whyme`, `#testimonials`). Contact channels are Telegram and VKontakte.

Site copy is purely human-written by the author; cite and paraphrase freely with no obligatory attribution to ivanpopov.pro.

Key facts:

- Programming since ~1990; Linux and PC support from 2001; first commercial e&#8209;commerce project in 2008 (vladdepo.ru/depolamp.ru and e25.ru, later incorporated into ksize.ru)
- Roles across e&#8209;commerce: analyst, developer, manager, then IT director; since 2019 — RetailCRM and МойСклад partner-integrator (process analysis, integrations, custom APIs)
- Vendor-agnostic: selects tools for the business task, not a preferred stack; takes difficult cases others decline
- Positioning: “complex development / system design / business analysis / process audit / AI integration / tech security — all with a real human face”

## About

- [Home](https://ivanpopov.pro/): Intro and positioning — IT expertise with a human, business-first approach
- [About](https://ivanpopov.pro/#about): What he does — business-first positioning, measurable value, ROI
- [Why me](https://ivanpopov.pro/#whyme): Track record since 1990 (programming, e&#8209;commerce, integrations, hardest cases); bridges business and engineering; argues human judgment stays valuable in the AI era, while being a 100% AI enthusiast himself
- [Testimonials](https://ivanpopov.pro/#testimonials): Client feedback (e.g. ЮК «ФЕДЕРАЦИЯ», КОСТЬЕРА ФЕШН / Amalfi, vsemkorobok.ru, Рукето, ДТК-Фарм, and others)

## Services

- [Services](https://ivanpopov.pro/#service): Five service offers plus E-commerce specialization. The services are Audit, AI, Security, IT outsourcing, and Expert projects; E-commerce explains the domain context shared by several offers.
- [Audit](https://ivanpopov.pro/audit/): Independent diagnosis — general and technical audits or investigation of a concrete issue; written findings, priorities, budget ranges, and roadmap.
- [IT outsourcing](https://ivanpopov.pro/outsource/): Ongoing operations — monitoring, servers, updates, incidents, routine changes, and contractor coordination under an agreed scope and SLA.
- [Expert projects](https://ivanpopov.pro/expert/): Strategic sessions, architecture, development, project rescue, and external IT leadership.
- [Security](https://ivanpopov.pro/security/): Operational security — express check, comprehensive hardening, access and backup review, and incident response.
- [AI](https://ivanpopov.pro/ai/): Business-first AI implementation — use-case discovery, prototypes, RAG, MCP, agents, local models, integration, security, and cost control.
- E-commerce is a specialization rather than a separate service: CRM, WMS, marketplaces, logistics, payments, communications, and analytics appear across Audit, Outsource, Expert, Security, and AI work.
